parsed.why: Strong rights law and high acceptance, but unremedied state exposures recur: birth-sex custody placement, isolation, strip-searches, border document questioning, and 64% trans discrimination prevalence. Oversight findings repeat without remedy, so Elevated Risk, not Reduced.

No gender-identity criminalisation and a third-gender tradition, but documented harassment and physical/sexual violence against visibly trans people in public and government settings, hostile leader rhetoric, and thin recourse. Extrapolated to Elevated Risk, low end.

Sodomy statute (14 years, sporadically enforced), police documented as main perpetrators of rape and beating of trans people with impunity, no protections, no recognition, near-total accountability collapse. Severe risk.

State threat-framing: 2024 package bans transition, markers, pride and gender expression; hate-crime law unenforced, mob attacks on assembly with victims arrested, trans woman killed post-passage. Efficiently hostile, unprotective institutions.

Permissive law, protected facilities access, working hate-crime and anti-discrimination enforcement, positive public climate; rollback bills only in first reading, an unresolved question rather than present exposure. Reduced Risk.
